inlines.v: MIT'TEN, noun 1. A cover for the hand, worn to defend it from cold or other injury. It differs from a glove, in not having a separate cover for each finger. 2. A cover for the arm only. To handle without mittens, to treat roughly; a popular colloquial phrase.
